steadicam.menu.title: Steadicam (anti motion sickness)
steadicam.hud.on: Steadicam on: view no longer sways
steadicam.hud.first_run: Steadicam is on. Press F7 to toggle anytime, or use Mod Menu > Steadicam to restore your settings
steadicam.advice: These are hers to change (this mod never touches them): shader depth-of-field and motion blur, mouse sensitivity, windowed mode, sitting farther from the screen
steadicam.tooltip.tier:
Weak: view bobbing, hurt tilt, FOV punch
Standard: also screen distortion, vignette, darkness
Strongest: also 120 fps cap, enchant glint, chunk fade, minecart roll
steadicam.tooltip.hud:
A level line that never moves, so the brain has a horizon
Hidden together with the HUD (F1)
